# rpersonalutils

The objective of this package is to serve as an easier way to write
functions or snippets that I commonly use.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `rpersonalutils` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Steven314/rpersonalutils")

# -- OR --

# intall.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Steven314/rpersonalutils")
```

There are no plans to release on CRAN as this is primarily for personal
use.

# Package index

## Database Interactions

### General

- [`collect_query()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/collect_query.md)
  : Collect Query from SQL File

### Oracle

- [`oracle_con()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/oracle_con.md)
  : Oracle Database Connection

### DuckDB

- [`duck_con()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/duck_con.md)
  : DuckDB Connection
- [`write_duckdb()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/write_duckdb.md)
  : Write a Table to a DuckDB Instance
- [`temp_duck_table()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/temp_duck_table.md)
  : Create a Temporary DuckDB Table
- [`attach_duckdb()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/attach_duckdb.md)
  : Attach an Additional DuckDB File to Connection
- [`install_duckdb_extension()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/install_duckdb_extension.md)
  : Install DuckDB Extensions Through HTTPS

## Table Investigation

- [`count_duplicates()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/count_duplicates.md)
  : Count Duplicate Rows
- [`` `%notin%` ``](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/grapes-notin-grapes.md)
  : Not In
- [`select_columns_na()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/select_columns_na.md)
  : Select Columns That Have Missing Values

## Calculation Shortcuts

- [`geographic_distance()`](https://slcarter.com/rpersonalutils/reference/geographic_distance.md)
  : Geographic Distance Between Two Pairs of Coordinates
